args.question:
Granite Facilities (V-628) has two invoices in 'approved' status, so I can't tell which one you mean. Which should I pay in full by wire (ACH if wire isn't available)?

- INV-31594: $5,525.32, due 2026-11-04
- INV-60776: $4,433.34, due 2026-11-25

(Not included: INV-86275, $5,572.00, is still a draft awaiting approval, and INV-23326 is already paid.) Reply with the invoice ID and I'll send one payment for it only.
